description: This file defines the class ThingModifyResponseSignalMapper, which extends AbstractModifySignalMapper for handling ThingModifyCommandResponse objects. It is responsible for mapping response signals related to 'modify' operations on 'things', performing validation, constructing topic paths, and enhancing payloads for message transmission.

classes.name: ThingModifyResponseSignalMapper
classes.description: A final class responsible for mapping modify response signals for 'things'. It extends AbstractModifySignalMapper parameterized with ThingModifyCommandResponse and implements ResponseSignalMapper.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the command response by ensuring its class name ends with 'Response'. Throws an exception if validation fails.

methods.name: getTopicPathBuilder
methods.description: Constructs and returns a TopicPathBuilder for the given command, focusing on 'things'.

methods.name: enhancePayloadBuilder
methods.description: Enhances the payload builder with status and value information extracted from the command response.
